title: Form Array By Concatenating Subarrays Of Another Array
description:
Given arrays of integer arrays `groups` and integer array `nums`, determine whether every group appears as a contiguous subarray of `nums`, in the same order as `groups`. The selected subarrays must be disjoint. Return `true` if this is possible and `false` otherwise.

## Examples

```text
Input: groups = [[10, -2], [1, 2, 3, 4]], nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 10, -2]
Output: false
```

```text
Input: groups = [[1, 2, 3], [3, 4]], nums = [7, 7, 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 7]
Output: false
```

```text
Input: groups = [[1, -1, 0], [3, -2]], nums = [1, -1, 0, 1, 3, -2]
Output: true
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= groups.length <= 10^3`
- `1 <= sum(len(groups[i])) <= 10^3`
- `1 <= len(nums) <= 10^3`
- All values are in `[-10^7, 10^7]`.
